programme.title: 正义女神
programme.desc: 【附中英文字幕】惠知赶往现场，目睹宇泽的母亲苏丽慈持刀挟持成彬，事态逐渐失控……一年后，惠知放弃升职，主动调迁少年法庭，更因此与光正离婚。工作严谨的惠知，与轻松的裁判法院法官们格格不入。海滨公园内，满身鲜血的姚振铭，向路经的裁判官郑邵文称砍伤了姊姊和妹妹。父亲认定振铭是妒忌姊姊得到偏爱而犯案，辩方律师程睿燊以振铭有精神问题抗辩。

programme.title: 家业
programme.desc: [附中英文字幕]明朝时期李墨世家八房幺女李祯（杨紫饰）为振兴家业，凭借制墨天赋带领李氏墨业重回巅峰，并与骆家次子骆文谦（韩东君饰）从竞争到合作，最终制出“天下第一墨”。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递
programme.desc: 故事主要围绕“熊氏一家”在家中的生活点滴和工作上的繁忙。

programme.title: 蜀锦人家
programme.desc: 讲述了以唐代益州浣花染坊的小姐季英英（谭松韵饰）面对外敌不卑不亢坚守染色秘方，而后又不拘一格将蜀锦独特的织染方法传播海外，最终被大唐封为织染使的传奇故事。

programme.title: 多情城市
programme.desc: 以1960至1970年代九份为背景，述说三个拜把兄弟如何赤手空拳打天下，藉由上一代的爱情故事串连两代之间共同的情感与记忆，深度探索两代之间的价值观差异。

programme.title: 台风的新娘

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: 帮规
programme.desc: 故事描述，元初元人派大将军莽依图打击反元分子；反元联盟潜龙帮正处外忧内患，伏帮主、石副帮主双双去世，继任人伏中原又为石夫人持信证明为元人，中原遂私下追寻身世真相。期间中原往将军府盗取结盟名册时，几乎遇险，幸为女飞贼林雪儿所救…

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: 射雕英雄传第三集
programme.desc: 郭靖和黄蓉为探寻武穆遗书而前往铁掌山。铁掌帮帮主裘千仞发现二人行踪后，把黄蓉打至重伤，但黄蓉的伤势却只有南帝段智兴才能治好。究竟黄蓉能否及时就医？

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: 春火
programme.desc: 杨国良是探长儿子，国良怪父沉迷工作，母离世仍在查案，隔膜顿生。国良遇上舞女梅琳，两人母亲皆殁，了解下迅即同居生活。国良因生活费花尽到俱乐部赌钱，被陈彪骗下巨款，更强奸梅琳。国良愤然杀死陈彪，遭警察围捕......

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the “Full Moon Scimitar”, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: 圆月弯刀
programme.desc: 青年侠士丁鹏连番击败多名武功高手，但却在一次与武术名家决战中惨败。他万念俱灰中拟自戕，却竟与魔教教主孙女青青邂逅。两人不久更到谈婚论嫁，教主特将一柄「圆月弯刀」赠予丁鹏，惟要他答应此生不离开魔教地界与青青白头到老…

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: 玫瑰我爱你
programme.desc: 十八岁的玫瑰在澳门结识了富家子家聪。太平洋战争爆发，两人被迫分手。七年后，玫瑰得知家聪结婚，伤心痛哭。玫瑰婚后，丈夫去世，开了一间花店，一天，小女孩来买花，才知小女孩是自己女儿，更与家聪重遇...文艺导演秦剑的爱情悲喜剧，保持作深情，感人之水准。

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: 恶霸
programme.desc: 年轻有为的侦缉队长召集两名狱卒，协助他对付经营赌博的黑帮。

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: 八国联军
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐败，社会民不聊生，慈禧太后与一群愚昧无知的权贵大臣不但毫无抵御外国列强侵占，以及保护人民的能力，反而迷信以吞符念咒，自称无坚不摧的「义和团」可以抵御洋人，决意向列强宣战。结果导致八国联军攻陷北京，慈禧太后仓惶逃难；人民这才醒悟到，只有孙中山先生领导的革命运动，才是挽救中国的唯一希望。

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: 无法无天飞车党
programme.desc: 文员郭静中，偕妻子陈美娟、妹嘉莉，乘搭渡轮往离岛渡假。同船而往者，有喜以飞车寻求刺激的「飞车党」；此次前往离岛，所有飞仔都各自带备一部电单车。「飞车党」之首叫尊尼，是个冷酷青年。其弟米高爱闯祸捣乱，亦是「飞车党」之一员。米高在船上见到性感的嘉莉，竟出手调戏……

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: 爱奴
programme.desc: 弱质少女金娥，被卖入妓院强迫接客，受尽欺凌，悲愤之余，假意奉承，化名爱奴，跟鸨母春姨学习奇特武功，又投其所好与春发展一段同性恋，目的就是报仇，后来爱奴将曾竞投她初夜的嫖客逐一杀死……。

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: 蝙蝠传奇
programme.desc: 楚留香与一点红自从在神水宫杀大破无花和尚后，又回到中原。结识了李玉函与柳无眉。在此之前，楚曾遇到连串莫名其妙的事情，后来，楚才知柳身患宿疾，她需要以楚的人头到蝙蝠岛去换取一种药物治病，是以欲置楚于死地，楚亲往蝙蝠岛了解事件，才惊觉阴谋中又有阴谋……

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: 舞衣
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，与空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住，三女各有爱情际遇；白眉虽爱钱，却倾情自称从外地来的路俊，两人只好互许后会有期之愿；朱黛曾迷恋已婚飞机师，分手后又爱上赛车手；姚姚的最大心愿是把清白之躯留给丈夫，她本最爱穷工人李吉，李吉却因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，却仍挂念李吉...

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: 猎魔者
programme.desc: 巨富之女贺盈聘请罗力到柬埔寨，从杀手乃汶处夺回商业秘密录音带。罗与好友组织一支敢死队，直赴游击队基地，成功将录音带交到贺手上后，方发现背后原来有极大的密秘...

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: 弟子也疯狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官与胡惠干三位俗家弟子初入少林，拜于南院戒嗔大师门下习武。然而，三人常与出家弟子悟清较劲切磋，寺中从此喧嚷不绝，连方丈见此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: 游侠情
programme.desc: 杜孟飞奉命下山闯荡江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉儿，杜挺身相救，沐万分感激。未几，杜又救出被黑道中人围攻的少女李赛男。及后，杜无意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首领是李之杀父仇人，而沐则是黑道首领失散的女儿…

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: 鱼美人
programme.desc: 张珍与金宠之女牡丹早有婚约，金宠却欲退婚。张珍偶遇化身金牡丹样子的鲤鱼精，两人渐生情愫。一天，金宠请包公来公断两个真假牡丹，包公为成全二人，推辞此案…

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: 柠檬可乐
programme.desc: 就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演《罗密欧与茱丽叶》而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽。这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家…

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: 窥情
programme.desc: 波子一夜用望远镜窥看家邻近四周时，揭发了一宗命案。但经警方调查村内居民，包括富商情妇Rita、邮差、纸店主老王及其妻子等人，揭开彼此间错综复杂的情欲关系之同时，还是不知谁是受害人，谁是凶手… 于是，波子决定用自己的方法继续调查…

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: 回魂夜
programme.desc: 老妇神秘堕楼死亡，鬼魂于回魂夜当晚出现作祟。弄得一众大厦保安员不得安宁，并邀请了捉鬼大师Leo与女助手相助。Leo从老妇鬼魂得知，她是被儿子及媳妇所杀害，为了让老妇安息，Leo答应将夫妇二人绳之以法...

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: 醉拳
programme.desc: 年轻气盛的黄飞鸿因招惹地方恶霸之子，被父亲送去跟随「醉拳大师」苏乞儿受训一年。当父亲揭发恶霸欲将国有矿产卖给日本人的阴谋后，顿成刺杀目标。为救父并阻止交易，飞鸿施展自创的「醉拳」，击败众杀手。

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: 靓女差馆
programme.desc: 雷女警长率领的港岛东刑事侦缉组的组员全是女警，因此有「靓女差馆」之称。警员生啤和沙爹对各女警一见难忘，遂主动申请调职到靓女差馆，意图接近众女并展开追求。这时，靓女差馆收到炸弹恐吓，她们最后能化解危机吗？

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: 白蛇传说
programme.desc: 这部奇幻动作片改编自中国经典传说《白蛇传》，讲述郎中许仙爱上化身为女子的千年白蛇。白蛇的真实身份被揭露后，高僧法海为守护人类与超自然力量之间的平衡，不得不挺身而出，展开一场惊心动魄的对决。

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: 精武风云 - 陈真
programme.desc: 1920年代的上海，陈真以年轻实业家身份潜伏，欲揭露黑社会头目与日军的勾结。他不仅要取得头目的信任，还需应对日军将领麾下杀手的重重狙杀。为隐匿行迹，他戴起黑色面具，联手警局队长，以威猛铁拳守护这座城市的爱国志士。

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: 最佳女婿
programme.desc: 新潮发型屋少东 Happy 哥与死党赖布甸、龙眼仔, 因抢走上海理发店板大松客人, 与他发生口角. 一夜, 三人胡涂地与松女儿阿英醉宿一宵, 之后英意外怀孕, 不知是谁才是经手人, 惟有待孩子出世后, 以血型辨别亲父, 怎料三人皆属同一血型...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: 无味神探
programme.desc: 故事根据真人实事改编，讲述香港督察刘镇海个性暴躁又好色，毒枭阿军欲杀他自保，但只令海失去味觉和嗅觉。妻子不忍见丈夫负伤累累因此尽释前嫌、尽心照顾。阿军得知海幷未身亡，胁持其妻作为谈判筹码。海为了救出妻子，只身一人与毒枭展开生死决战...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: 种鬼
programme.desc: 故事描述，计程车司机周通(高飞饰)之妻艾莲(玄智慧饰)红杏出墙，搭上赌场常客方明(徐少强饰)。一日，艾与方争执后独自离去，却被流氓挟往荒屋施暴，艾极力反抗，终堕楼惨死。周受一股神秘力量引导，发现艾尸首，蒙眬间，闻鬼语遣其往找巫师设法报仇。自始怪事接连发生，所有与艾之死有关的人均遭鬼怪缠扰...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: 裂战
programme.desc: 为了对抗温室效应，女科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，前往一个荒岛进行种植，希望将那里改变为一片欣欣向荣的新土地。然而，她的前夫决定在这趟危险的旅程中保护她，与她结伴同行。抵达后，他们面临接连不断的冲突，并遇上当地的贩毒组织，一场生死对决随即展开。

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: 韩城攻略
programme.desc: 特工林贵仁隶属日本国防外务科特别侦缉组，他与一名飞贼联手，试图窃取两块美金伪钞电版。然而，当电版被美国大使馆人员盗走并带到韩国后，整个事件变得更加复杂棘手。

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: 龙虎武师
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际。这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像资料，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙、甄子丹及洪金宝。

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌(欧阳震华)错手杀害女友杨夕雪(关咏荷)。在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯(欧阳震华)身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜(关咏荷)出现眼前。包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安(黄智贤)陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙(欧阳震华)探长。在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤(关咏荷)却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人。龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排。悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤。金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者……

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)’s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波……当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面……

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘……

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。 失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey

Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey

programme.title: 情逆三世缘
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌(欧阳震华)错手杀害女友杨夕雪(关咏荷)。在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯(欧阳震华)身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜(关咏荷)出现眼前。包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安(黄智贤)陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙(欧阳震华)探长。在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤(关咏荷)却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人。龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排。悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤。金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者……

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)’s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波……当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面……

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘……

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。 失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. programme.title: 情逆三世缘
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌(欧阳震华)错手杀害女友杨夕雪(关咏荷)。在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯(欧阳震华)身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜(关咏荷)出现眼前。包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安(黄智贤)陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙(欧阳震华)探长。在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤(关咏荷)却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人。龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排。悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤。金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者……
